claim: Trade reporting says BrowsAble secured GBP 300,000 for adaptive accessibility tooling.
verifiedFacts: A November 2 report states BrowsAble received a GBP 150,000 Innovate UK grant matched by EHE Group investment.
The report describes a proposed browser extension and website install script for simplified layouts.
A 2027 launch is planned; no independent user-outcome or compliance evidence was found.
inference: Accessible interface audits remain a more defensible service than relying on a third-party overlay.
A buyer-facing native keyboard, zoom, screen-reader, and reduced-motion QA receipt is a bounded proof.
The funding report reinforces inclusive design demand but does not establish customer purchases.
Advisory disposition: PRODUCTIZE Mochi UI and Melodyfire QA; REFERENCE-ONLY FLORÉ.
significance: Reported matched investment provides a market signal for adaptive accessibility, with efficacy still unverified.
assumptions: The trade report correctly describes the grant and matching investment.
knownLimitations: Primary grant award and investment documentation not accessed; no independent usability or WCAG study.
